visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: try-with-resources Instead of try/finally
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A try / finally with a null check closes the resource by hand. Use try-with-resources. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: try-with-resources closes the resource even when the body throws, skips the null check, and, unlike a hand-written finally, does not lose the original exception if close() fails too.
